title: Claim
description: An atomic claim extracted from the report. claim_id = sha256(section_id + sentence_text)[:16].

claim_type.description: Only factual claims hard-fail on lack of support

cited_source_ids.description: Stable source_ids cited for this claim

evidence_ids.description: Evidence rows that support this claim

support_status.description: Set by verify_claim_support.py (deterministic red-flag filter); semantic verdicts live in claim_ledger.jsonl

_support_score.description: Written by verify_claim_support.py verify: best lexical support score of the linked evidence (0.0 none .. 1.0 strong)

_support_notes.description: Written by verify_claim_support.py verify: why the score/status was assigned (e.g. 'negation mismatch with evidence')
